title: Prototype Pattern
overview: Create new objects by copying an existing object, avoiding the cost of creating from scratch.
useCases: Objects to be created are similar to an existing instance
Many expensive parts can be shared between copies
exampleUses: Duplicating a fully configured document template (with styles, headers, footers) to start a new document
Cloning game entities (enemies, projectiles) at runtime instead of re-reading their config from disk each time
Copying a complex UI component tree so the user can edit a draft without affecting the original
